title: Overview
summary: Introduces the report’s scope, functional areas, and organizational structure of the Federal Reserve.

title: Monetary Policy and Economic Developments
summary: Analyzes monetary policy actions, inflation, labor market, GDP growth, and balance‑sheet developments for 2023.

sub_nodes.title: March 2024 Summary
sub_nodes.summary: Reviews inflation easing, labor market tightness, and FOMC’s stance on interest rates as of March 2024.

sub_nodes.title: June 2023 Summary
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes inflation, labor market conditions, GDP growth, and policy actions up to June 2023.

title: Financial Stability
summary: Describes monitoring of financial vulnerabilities, domestic and international coordination, and stability‑related activities.

sub_nodes.title: Monitoring Financial Vulnerabilities
sub_nodes.summary: Presents the framework for assessing asset valuations, borrowing, leverage, and funding risks.

sub_nodes.title: Domestic and International Cooperation and Coordination
sub_nodes.summary: Outlines collaboration with FSOC, FSB, and other agencies to promote global financial stability.

title: Supervision and Regulation
summary: Covers the Federal Reserve’s supervisory role, institution categories, regulatory actions, and specialized examinations.

sub_nodes.title: Supervised and Regulated Institutions
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the types and numbers of banks, holding companies, and other entities under Fed supervision.

sub_nodes.title: Supervisory Developments
sub_nodes.summary: Details response to bank failures, examination statistics, and ongoing supervisory priorities.

sub_nodes.title: Specialized Examinations
sub_nodes.summary: Describes focused examinations on stress testing, fiduciary activities, cybersecurity, and other specialized areas.

sub_nodes.title: Enforcement Actions and Financial Disclosures
sub_nodes.summary: Reports 63 formal and 99 informal enforcement actions in 2023 and disclosures required of state member banks.

sub_nodes.title: Internal Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the two‑level appeal process for material supervisory determinations and 2023 appeal statistics.

sub_nodes.title: Assessments, Training, and Technical Assistance
sub_nodes.summary: Covers cost assessments for large institutions, training for foreign supervisors, and outreach to minority‑owned depositories.

sub_nodes.title: International Engagement and Standard‑Setting
sub_nodes.summary: Details participation in FSB, Basel Committee, CPMI, and IAIS activities and related 2023 publications.

sub_nodes.title: Shared National Credit Program
sub_nodes.summary: Explains the interagency review of large shared credits and 2023 review schedule.

sub_nodes.title: Bank Secrecy Act and Anti‑Money‑Laundering Compliance
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes BSA/AML examination responsibilities, AML Act updates, and interagency coordination in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: Regulatory Reports and Rulemakings
sub_nodes.summary: Lists major 2023 regulatory reporting form revisions, rulemakings, guidance, and related agency releases.

title: Payment System and Reserve Bank Oversight
summary: Covers regulatory proposals, technology initiatives, facility upgrades, oversight activities, financial statements, SOMA holdings, and priced‑services pro‑forma statements.

sub_nodes.title: Regulation II proposal
sub_nodes.summary: Board sought comment on lowering maximum interchange fee for large debit cards and setting a biennial update process.

sub_nodes.title: Master Account and Services Database
sub_nodes.summary: Database launched in June 2023 to disclose entities with access to Reserve Bank master accounts and related services.

sub_nodes.title: Technology initiatives and cybersecurity
sub_nodes.summary: FedNow implementation, modernized payment platforms, and cyber‑risk mitigation programs to enhance resilience and security.

sub_nodes.title: Facility renovation programs
sub_nodes.summary: Multi‑year upgrades to mechanical, electrical, and vault facilities at several Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: Oversight and audit of Reserve Banks
sub_nodes.summary: Board’s annual combined audit, COSO internal‑control assessments, and KPMG audit of financial statements and controls.

sub_nodes.title: Financial statements and SOMA holdings
sub_nodes.summary: Income, expenses, net loss, and detailed SOMA asset, liability, and lending program data for 2023 and 2022.

sub_nodes.title: Pro forma priced‑services statements
sub_nodes.summary: Balance‑sheet and income‑statement pro forma for priced services, including revenue, expenses, imputed costs, and cost recovery.

title: Organizational Structure and Leadership
summary: Details divisions, committees, councils, leadership conferences and related governance entities of the Federal Reserve System.

sub_nodes.title: Division of Research and Statistics
sub_nodes.summary: Lists senior staff and directors overseeing economic research and statistical analysis.

sub_nodes.title: Division of Supervision and Regulation
sub_nodes.summary: Identifies leadership of the division responsible for supervision and regulatory oversight.

sub_nodes.title: Division of Consumer and Community Affairs
sub_nodes.summary: Names directors handling consumer protection and community outreach programs.

sub_nodes.title: Division of Reserve Bank Operations and Payment Systems
sub_nodes.summary: Provides leadership roster for operations, payment systems, and related technology.

sub_nodes.title: Division of Management
sub_nodes.summary: Lists senior managers responsible for overall administration and IT functions.

sub_nodes.title: Office of Inspector General
sub_nodes.summary: Identifies the Inspector General and senior staff overseeing audits and investigations.

sub_nodes.title: Federal Open Market Committee
sub_nodes.summary: Names members, alternate members, and meeting schedule for the FOMC in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: Board of Governors Advisory Councils
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Federal Advisory Council and its 2023 meeting dates and members.

sub_nodes.title: Model Validation Council
sub_nodes.summary: Notes the council’s purpose and that it held no meetings in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: Reserve Bank and Branch Leadership
sub_nodes.summary: Lists chairs, presidents, vice presidents and other leaders for each Reserve Bank and its branches.

sub_nodes.title: Leadership Conferences
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes the Conference of Chairs and Conference of Presidents activities and officers for 2023.

sub_nodes.title: Conference of First Vice Presidents
sub_nodes.summary: Details officers and election outcomes for the First Vice Presidents conference in 2023.

title: Budgets and Financial Information
summary: Presents operating expenses, employment, capital budgets, currency program, and policy actions for 2023‑2024.

sub_nodes.title: Total Operating Expenses
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.1 shows system‑wide expenses, revenue, and net operating cost for 2023‑2024.

sub_nodes.title: Employment Statistics
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.2 provides full‑time‑equivalent counts for Board, OIG and Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: Board of Governors Budget Details
sub_nodes.summary: Operating‑area, division, and account‑classification expense tables (D.3‑D.7) and position authorizations.

sub_nodes.title: Operating Expenses by Area
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.3 breaks down Board expenses across monetary policy, supervision, payment system, and consumer protection.

sub_nodes.title: Expenses by Division
sub_nodes.summary: Tables D.4‑D.5 detail division‑level spending and goods‑vs‑personnel allocations.

sub_nodes.title: Account Classification Summary
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.5 aggregates personnel services, goods and services, and depreciation for the Board.

sub_nodes.title: Authorized Positions
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.6 lists position authorizations by division and compares 2023 actual to 2024 budget.

sub_nodes.title: Office of Inspector General Budget
sub_nodes.summary: OIG expense, income, and capital tables (D.5, D.7) and discussion of strategic‑plan goals.

sub_nodes.title: Reserve Banks Budget Overview
sub_nodes.summary: Process description and tables D.8‑D.11 covering district expenses, operating areas, account classes, and employment.

sub_nodes.title: Operating Expenses by District
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.8 reports each Reserve Bank’s total expenses for 2023‑2024.

sub_nodes.title: Operating Expenses by Area
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.9 breaks down expenses into monetary policy, Treasury services, public services, supervision and fee‑based services.

sub_nodes.title: Operating Expenses by Account Classification
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.10 presents salaries, building, software, equipment and other cost categories.

sub_nodes.title: Employment by District
sub_nodes.summary: Table D.11 gives FTE counts for each District, National IT and OEB.

sub_nodes.title: Reserve Banks Capital Expenditures
sub_nodes.summary: Tables D.12‑D.14 detail district‑level capital projects, multicycle BEP projects, and total system capital spending.

sub_nodes.title: Currency Budget and Program
sub_nodes.summary: Discussion of Board’s currency responsibilities, BEP single‑cycle and multicycle budgets, and education program.

sub_nodes.title: Record of Policy Actions
sub_nodes.summary: Appendix documenting 2023 regulatory rules, policy statements, interest‑rate decisions, and BTFP actions.

sub_nodes.title: Government Performance and Results Act Reporting
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Board’s voluntary GPRA compliance, strategic plan 2020‑23, annual performance plan and report.

title: Litigation
summary: Summary of lawsuits and appeals involving the Board in 2023, including pending and resolved cases.

title: Statistical Tables
summary: Series of tables presenting open‑market transactions, holdings, reserve requirements, banking office data, and historic reserve statistics.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.1 – Open Market Transactions 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Monthly totals of Treasury and agency securities purchases, sales, exchanges, and redemptions.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.2 – Federal Reserve Bank Holdings 2021‑23
sub_nodes.summary: Values of Treasury, agency, and mortgage‑backed securities held outright by Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.3 – Reserve Requirements 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Requirement percentages for net transaction accounts, nonpersonal time deposits, and eurocurrency.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.4 – Banking Offices and BHC‑Affiliated Banks 2022‑23
sub_nodes.summary: Counts of commercial banks, branches, and BHC‑affiliated institutions with changes during 2023.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.5A – Reserves and Credit 1984‑2023
sub_nodes.summary: Annual and monthly data on reserve factors, Federal Reserve credit, securities, and temporary transactions.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.5B – Historic Reserves 1918‑1983
sub_nodes.summary: Year‑end and annual data on reserve factors, credit, securities and other balance‑sheet items.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.6 – Insured Commercial Bank Balance Sheets 2022‑2023
sub_nodes.summary: Assets, liabilities, and equity of member and nonmember insured commercial banks.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.7 – Initial Margin Requirements
sub_nodes.summary: Historical margin percentages under Regulations T, U, and X for stocks and convertible bonds.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.8A – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, continued
sub_nodes.summary: Detailed balance‑sheet items for each Reserve Bank, including liabilities, capital accounts and totals.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.8B – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, 2023 and 2022
sub_nodes.summary: Federal Reserve notes, collateral, and total liabilities and capital accounts for 2023‑2022.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.9 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Comprehensive income and expense data for each Reserve Bank, including net income and Treasury remittances.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.10 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, 1914–2023
sub_nodes.summary: Historical financial tables covering over a century of Reserve Bank income, expenses, and capital.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.11 – Operations in principal departments of the Federal Reserve Banks, 2020–23
sub_nodes.summary: Counts of currency, checks, securities and fund transfers processed by the Banks.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.12 – Number and annual salaries of officers and employees of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Staffing levels and compensation for officers and employees across all Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: Table G.13 – Acquisition costs and net book value of the premises of the Federal Reserve Banks and Branches, December 31, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Acquisition costs and net book values for land, buildings and other real estate of each Bank.
